outcome.answer: LLMs can reuse specific workflows by abstracting past trajectories into reusable skills or structural priors, then retrieving those for similar new tasks instead of rerunning everything from scratch [1, 2, 10]. LifeMem clusters interaction trajectories by underlying workflows and recalls relevant skills and trajectories at inference time to reduce forgetting and improve transfer [1]. SWIFT distills compositional heuristics and workflow demonstrations from prior search trajectories, while TRIAGE turns historical execution trajectories into skills for direct reuse or parameter substitution on similar queries [2, 10].
